sources.title: Recommended parameters for reporting on GHG projections in 2023, Version after consultation of WG2 under the Climate Change Committee on 10 March 2022, sharing of draft recommendation on 30 March 2022 and consultation of National Experts designated by members of WG2 on 26 April 2022,
sources.description: This document provides guidance to European Member States on which parameter calibrations are recommended / suggested for their projections. The data are made available every reporting year on reportnet under datflow 113 linked to a zip file. Reportnet is maintained by the European Environment Agency. Information from it was used for the parameter calibration for population and real GDP growth rate (population all years, GDP for the years 2031-2050).
